symptom: Item 3 of saingge's comment on mendixlabs/mxcli#1517 (ako/mxcli#1399), last form: under `mdl 1;` a re-run `create or modify` that rewords, adds or removes a free note (an `@annotation(text: …, position: …)` attached to nothing) is refused: 'the free annotations change (note "free one" is now "free one, reworded"); the splice edits activities only'
cause: diffFlowBody compares the flow's free notes as a whole and refused any difference: the splice had operations for activities and for notes on a node, none for a note on the canvas
file: mdl/backend/mfmutator/splice.go (SetFreeNotes), mdl/backend/microflow_mutation.go (interface), mdl/backend/mcp/microflow_mutator.go (refused), mdl/executor/cmd_flow_modify.go (diffFlowBody, planFlowModify), mdl/executor/flow_splice_node_notes.go (setFreeNotes)
fix: New mutator op SetFreeNotes(frag): removes every top-level annotation no line attaches and appends the fragment's unattached annotations. diffFlowBody returns the declared free notes when they differ (after the misplaced-attached-note hint, which still refuses); planFlowModify builds them as free notes of a stand-in `log` and applies SetFreeNotes after the ops and header, reporting 'set: free notes'. A free note with an id is refused
test: mdl/executor/flow_splice_free_notes_pedapp_test.go TestCreateOrModify_FreeNotesChangeInPlace (reworded, added, removed; every other object kept, attached note kept, re-run Unchanged); mfmutator splice_notes_add_test.go TestSplice_SetFreeNotesReplacesOnlyTheFreeNotes. Before the change all three executor subtests failed with the reported refusal. The note-order test's control (a new free note) now asserts it is written
insight: A change that has no target does not fit the op list (every op is aimed at a stored candidate); it belongs beside the moves and the header, applied once to the open mutator, and it must be reported through `set` or the run says Unchanged while it writes. Order matters there too: SetHeader assigns p.set, so anything appended to it has to come after
